prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/nightly-report.yml that runs every night at 03:00 UTC, uses this repo's wrangler to run the R2 SQL query `SELECT status, count(*) AS n FROM default.orders GROUP BY status` against our warehouse `0123abcd4567ef_analytics`, and uploads the output as a build artifact named order-report. The query token is in the repository secret R2_SQL_TOKEN. Our CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret is for deploys only and must not be used in this workflow.

correct..github/workflows/nightly-report.yml:
name: Nightly report
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * *"
jobs:
  report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx wrangler r2 sql query 0123abcd4567ef_analytics "SELECT status, count(*) AS n FROM default.orders GROUP BY status" > order-report.txt
        env:
          WRANGLER_R2_SQL_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.R2_SQL_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.R2_SQL_TOKEN }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: order-report
          path: order-report.txt

name: Nightly report

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * *"

jobs:
  report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Run the query
        run: npx wrangler basin sql query 0123abcd4567ef_analytics "SELECT status, count(*) AS n FROM default.orders GROUP BY status" > order-report.txt
        env:
          WRANGLER_BASIN_SQL_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.R2_SQL_TOKEN }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: order-report
          path: order-report.txt

name: Nightly report
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'
jobs:
  report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TOKEN: ${{ secrets.R2_SQL_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: WRANGLER_BASIN_SQL_AUTH_TOKEN="$TOKEN" npx wrangler r2 sql query 0123abcd4567ef_analytics "SELECT status, count(*) AS n FROM default.orders GROUP BY status" | tee order-report.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: order-report
          path: order-report.txt
